results.title: Nepal's Loss and Damage Allocation Too Short | ESG News.earth
results.snippet:
##### Backdrop:

In late August 2026, severe climate-induced flash floods struck Nepal, triggered by a massive mountain slope failure near the Langtang Lirung peak in Rasuwa district along the Nepal-China border. The sudden collapse sent torrents through the Bhote Koshi, Trishuli, and Narayani river systems, destroying riverside settlements, bridges, energy infrastructure, and agricultural lands.
